name: hcportal_clearEmailBounce
description: Portal door to clearing a hasher's bounced or suspect email status from a run's "Who gets the email" list (E19.F4.S5). Parity twin of HC6.hcapp_clearEmailBounce: same gate, same shared worker HC6.nonApi_resetEmailStatus. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with a NULL callerParamString (the token is not bound to the run or hasher). Gate: HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'createEditRuns' on the run's kennel (a hare of the run qualifies via @isHareOfEvent), and the target hasher must have a non-removed HasherKennelMap row for that kennel or any HasherEventMap row for the run. Resets EmailStatus to 0 (Unknown) and the soft-bounce count to 0; never touches EmailBlocked (the member's own opt-out).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: registered portal device. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived portal token, validated with a NULL callerParamString.

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: The run whose email list the hasher appears on. Identification only; resolved to HC.Event.id (deleted = 0 AND removed = 0). NULL returns 'The run or the hasher was missing.'

parameters.name: hasherId
parameters.description: The hasher whose email status is cleared. NULL returns 'The run or the hasher was missing.'

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on auth failure, missing parameter, run not found, not authorised, or hasher not in the run's audience. Two columns only — the hasherId/emailStatus columns are absent on these paths.

rowsets.name: ResultEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on success, and from the CATCH block (Success = 0, hasherId and emailStatus NULL).

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success; 'The bounce could not be cleared. Please try again.' from CATCH

columns.name: hasherId
columns.description: Lowercase hasher id; NULL from CATCH

columns.name: emailStatus
columns.description: HC.Hasher.EmailStatus after the reset (0 Unknown, 1 OK, 2 Suspect, 3 Bounced); NULL from CATCH. Column added by db/hc6/app/archive/2026-10-09_hasher_email_status_columns.sql (not yet in db/schema/tables).

sideEffects: EXEC HC6.nonApi_resetEmailStatus @hasherId, @reason = 'cleared by admin <userId>': UPDATE HC.Hasher SET EmailStatus = 0, EmailSoftBounceCount = 0, EmailStatusChangedAt = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() when either is non-zero; never sets updatedAt (no re-sync)
INSERT LOG.GeneralLog (LogSource 'EmailStatus', 'Email status reset') when a row changed
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 'Not authorised', 'Not in audience' and unhandled errors

codeSmells.detail: Early-exit error paths (lines 28, 34, 43, 56, 65) return two columns; success and CATCH (lines 75, 82) return four. Clients must not index hasherId/emailStatus unless Success = 1.

codeSmells.issue: INSERT ... EXEC of a proc whose CATCH rolls back
codeSmells.detail: Line 72 runs HC6.nonApi_resetEmailStatus under INSERT-EXEC. If that proc fails, its CATCH ROLLBACK is illegal inside INSERT-EXEC (error 3915), so its own HC.ErrorLog row is lost and the outer CATCH (line 80) logs the 3915 message rather than the original error.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
